stories.title: ‘Street Fighter’ Star Callina Liang Swaps Chun-Li’s Battle Scars for Red-Carpet Glam in New Photos

film_facts.title: Street Fighter
film_facts.critics_consensus: The latest iteration of Street Fighter has plenty of affection for its source material and doesn't lack for dizzying style, but its incoherent storytelling and juvenile humor make for a disappointing regression among video game adaptations.
film_facts.critics_overview: It received a 65% definite recommend for children under 12. The audience was 30% Latino and Hispanic, 29% Caucasian, 21% Black, 14% Asian American and 6% Native American or Other.
